description: POST /v2/files takes the file bytes as an application/octet-stream body. The shared OpenAPI converter models application/json request bodies only, so the operation would otherwise upload nothing — and every `createANewDeployment` that references files depends on this call having actually sent them. Adds the whole-body member plus the media type the protocol sends it under.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The file contents, sent verbatim as application/octet-stream. The docs mark the body optional — Vercel accepts a bodyless call that only registers the `x-Vercel-Digest` of an already-uploaded file.
